songTitle: Kal Tak Jo Roz Ka Tha

scenes.name: Classroom Window & Morning Chime
scenes.subtitle: Acoustic fingerstyle prelude • Morning sunlight streaming through dusty school windowpanes

scenes.name: Kal Tak Jo Roz Ka Tha
scenes.sectionTag: 02 // MUKHDA  •  EK BENCH PE BEETA LAMHA
scenes.subtitle: The wooden bench where whole worlds were built • Time slipped away silently

lines.text: Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya,
Ek bench pe beeta lamha, Poora jahaan ban gaya.
Hum keh na paaye, “Thoda ruk jaa,” Waqt magar chalta gaya,
Classroom toh chhoot gaya, Par dil wahin reh gaya...
Woh din kahaan kho gaye, Hum jaane kab bade ho gaye...
Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya.

scenes.name: Corridor Steps & Distant Bell
scenes.subtitle: Acoustic fingerstyle strumming • Footsteps echoing in quiet corridors after the bell

scenes.name: Subah Ki Jaldi & Notes Banwaana
scenes.subtitle: Stealing sips from one water bottle • The comfort of a familiar face at the school gate

lines.text: Subah-subah ki jaldi, Aadhi neend mein woh safar,
Gate pe tera mil jaana, Jaise mil gaya ho ghar.
Attendance mein teri awaaz, Meri hansi ka chhup jaana,
Khud kuchh bhi yaad na hona, Phir bhi notes banwaana.
Ek tiffin mein chaar haath, Ek bottle, saare yaar,
Chhoti-chhoti si baaton pe, Hota tha kitna pyaar.
Paper se pehle kasmein, “Bhai, aaj toh fail hain hum!”
Paper ke baad wahi chehre, “Bach gaye, milte hain kal!”

scenes.name: Mukhda Reprise & Unsaid Words
scenes.subtitle: We never asked time to slow down • The quiet realization that school was ending

lines.text: Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya,
Ek bench pe beeta lamha, Poora jahaan ban gaya.
Hum keh na paaye, “Thoda ruk jaa,” Waqt magar chalta gaya,
Classroom toh chhoot gaya, Par dil wahin reh gaya...
Woh din kahaan kho gaye, Hum jaane kab bade ho gaye...
Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya.

scenes.name: Canteen Steam & Flute Melodic Drift
scenes.subtitle: Warm flute & acoustic interlude • Steam rising from canteen chai glasses

scenes.name: Canteen Chai & Last Bench Rules
scenes.subtitle: Where own rules ruled supreme • Respectable on the outside, reckless dreamers within

lines.text: Canteen ki woh chai, Aur samose ke woh hisse,
Bina wajah ke hansna, Aur rooth jaana kisse-kisse.
Woh last bench ki duniya, Jahaan apne hi usool,
Baahar se hum shareef the, Andar se bilkul fizool.
Jis period se bhaagte the, Aaj usi ko dhoondhte hain,
Jis lecture mein so jaate the, Usi awaaz ko sochte hain.
Woh teachers ki daant mein, Chhupi fikr ka ehsaas,
Tab toh bas chhutti chahiye thi, Ab wohi din khaas.
Tasveeron mein sab hain lekin, Woh pal kahin milta nahi,
Sabke chehre yaad hain mujhko, Bas waqt laut-ta nahi...

scenes.name: Mukhda — Emotional Reprise
scenes.sectionTag: 08 // REPRISE  •  AANKHON MEIN THAM SA GAYA
scenes.subtitle: Where did those golden days vanish? • Growing up without noticing the hours

lines.text: Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya,
Ek bench pe baitha lamha, Aankhon mein tham sa gaya.
Hum keh na paaye, “Saath rehna,” Har koi chalta gaya,
Classroom toh chhoot gaya, Par dil wahin reh gaya...
Woh din kahaan kho gaye, Hum jaane kab bade ho gaye...
Bachpan ke woh raaste, Jaane kahaan mud gaye...

scenes.name: Farewell Bell & Quiet Courtyard
scenes.subtitle: Solemn acoustic resonance • Silence settling over the school ground on the final afternoon

scenes.name: Bridge — The Last Day
scenes.sectionTag: 10 // BRIDGE  •  THE LAST DAY & GROUP PHOTO
scenes.subtitle: Names scrawled on the green blackboard • Standing in the corner of the group photograph

lines.text: Aakhri din tha, sab hans rahe the, Koi nahi tha jo ro raha tha,
Par ghar aake samajh mein aaya, Kuchh toh peeche chhoot raha tha.
Board pe likhe the naam hamaare, Desk pe aadhi si ek lakeer,
Kal tak paas baithe the jo, Aaj ho gaye sab door-door.
Kisi ne kaha, “Contact mein rehna,” Kisi ne bas haath hilaaya,
Group photo ke uss kone mein, Maine apna kal chhupaya.
Kaash koi uss pal keh deta, “Yeh waqt phir nahi aayega,”
Hum thodi der aur ruk jaate, Koi ghar nahi jaayega...

scenes.name: Final Mukhda — Cinematic Climax
scenes.sectionTag: 11 // CLIMAX  •  UNKE BINA JAHAAN TANHA HUA
scenes.subtitle: Meeting them used to feel so ordinary • Without them, the world feels lonely

lines.text: Kal tak jo roz ka tha, Aaj woh yaad ban gaya,
Jinse milna aam sa lagta tha, Unke bina jahaan tanha hua.

scenes.name: Guitar Solo & Nostalgic Montage
scenes.subtitle: Soaring guitar solo • Decades passing like shadows across the classroom wall

scenes.name: Reprise Tag & Last Echo
scenes.sectionTag: 13 // REPRISE  •  PAR DIL WAHIN REH GAYA
scenes.subtitle: The school bell rings no more • But the heart still waits at that old crossroad

lines.text: Ab woh ghanti nahi bulaati, Na koi naam pukarta hai,
Dil aaj bhi uss mod pe jaakar, Doston ka intezaar karta hai...
Classroom toh chhoot gaya... Par dil wahin reh gaya.

scenes.name: Outro — Student Life Dil Se Kabhi Khatam Hoti Nahi
scenes.subtitle: If we meet again, let's smile as if we met only yesterday • Because student life never ends

lines.text: Kabhi milna toh phir se milna, Jaise kal hi mile the hum,
Na poochhna kitne badal gaye, Bas hans dena pehle ki tarah...
Kyunki kuchh dost, kuchh yaadein, Kabhi puraani hoti nahi...
Zindagi aage badh jaati hai, Par student life... Dil se kabhi khatam hoti nahi.
